item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Teen boy found dead in Spring Hill retention pond, sheriff says no signs of foul play
item.description: A teenage boy was found dead in a retention pond in Spring Hill on Saturday morning, and investigators do not currently believe he was the victim of a violent crime.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Woman's remains found near Sunshine Skyway Bridge in Manatee County, deputies say
item.description: Investigators are working to identify an adult woman whose partial remains washed ashore near the Sunshine Skyway Bridge on Saturday morning, according to the Manatee County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Teenage boy found dead near retention pond in Spring Hill: HCSO
item.description: A teenage boy was found dead Saturday morning near a retention pond near Belkton Avenue and Curry Drive, according to the Hernando County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ceiling collapses inside Kennedy Center amid fight over Trump-led renovations
item.description: A section of ceiling collapsed inside the Kennedy Center during storms, intensifying debate over Trump-backed plans to renovate and temporarily close the venue.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] What to expect on Labor Day: Closures, travel and store hours
item.description: Labor Day means closures for banks, post offices and government offices, but most major retailers, restaurants and travel hubs will remain open.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rescues in Action: Glinda, Oliver & Felix, and Willow
item.description: Willow is slightly timid and in need of a loving home, Oliver and Felix have big personalities, sweet hearts, and plenty of puppy charm and Glinda is looking for a home with her two sons!

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Catholic Charities getting Tampa's homeless back on their feet
item.description: Catholic Charities held a clothing giveaway and a raffle at their Tampa Hope site on 3rd Ave. on Saturday, for those who are trying to turn their lives around.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 26th annual GeckoFest returns to Gulfport streets
item.description: Gulfport is turning up the volume this weekend as the 26th annual GeckoFest takes over Beach and Shore Boulevards. The free event brings live music, street performers, and food trucks to the water-loving community.
